Dave Matthews Band
August 29, 2023
Hayden Homes Amphitheater
Bend, OR

Taper: Ryan Hoyt
Equipment: dpa4023 > sx-r4+ (non-US version)
Location: FOH, mics DIN at 10'
Conversion: MBIT+ Dithering to 16 bit

*** A 24/96 version of this source exists ***

Notes:
 - compiled 2023-09-02
 - Some wind noise is present in the first part of the set
 - Thanks to the crowd around me for keeping the stand protected
   all night!
 - A set of dpa4011s was also on the same stand, with the same 
   pattern (DIN), the same windscreens (DPA UA0896), and the same
   preamp/ adc (r4+). This was done to compare the 4023s which were
   noted by DPA as out of spec. The two tapes should sound almost
   exactly the same. In this version, tracks 3 and 4 were edited to 
   match the 4011s volume. For these two tracks, I matched the gain
   on the preamp for all 4 channels (+32.3 db). This showed there was
   about a 7 db difference between the 4023s and the 4011s. I added that
   back in post for this copy. The un-edited files are also available.
   Thank you to Scott Brown for the loan of the r4+ to do the comparison!
